mentions.name: Weekend-Only Snack Box
mentions.description: A lockable hardware box that only opens on weekends, built to curb frequent snacking. The build uses a Raspberry Pi Pico board prototyped on a breadboard, hand-soldered components, and a custom 3D printed enclosure designed to fit the Pico.
mentions.problem: Frequent snacking that the builder wanted to restrict to weekends.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been snacking too often so I've been building a box that will only open on the weekends.

evidence.value: I've been snacking too often so I've been building a box that will only open on the weekends.
